endorsements.name: Tamir Ariel
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-22636
endorsements.description: Texas Instruments TI-RTOS, when configured to use HeapMem heap(default), malloc returns a valid pointer to a small buffer on extremely large values, which can trigger an integer overflow vulnerability in 'HeapMem_allocUnprotected' and result in code execution.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.4)
